<header class="topbar" id="topbar"><div class="identity"><strong>BRENDAN MCGOVERN</strong><span>CREATIVE + ART DIRECTOR + DESIGNER</span></div><button class="menu-toggle" id="menuToggle" aria-label="Open menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="menuPanel"></button></header><aside class="menu-panel" id="menuPanel"><div class="menu-head"><span>SELECTED WORK</span><button class="menu-close" id="menuClose">CLOSE ×</button></div><div class="menu-projects" id="menuProjects"></div><div class="menu-links"><a href="#about">ABOUT</a><a href="mailto:hello@example.com">CONTACT</a></div></aside>
<section class="intro" id="intro"><div class="stage" id="stage"><canvas id="c"></canvas><img id="heroLogo" class="hero-logo" src="ideas-fc-logo.svg" alt="Ideas FC"><div class="cue" id="cue">SWIPE / SCROLL</div></div></section>
<section class="gallery" id="gallery"><div class="gallery-head">SELECTED WORK</div><div class="object-grid" id="grid"></div></section>
<section class="case" id="case"><button class="case-close" id="caseClose">CLOSE ×</button><div class="case-inner"><header class="case-hero" id="caseHero"><div class="case-hero-shade"></div><div class="case-hero-copy"><h1 class="case-title" id="caseTitle"></h1><div class="case-client-hero" id="caseClientHero"></div><div class="case-kicker" id="caseKicker">01 / Campaign / Creative Direction</div></div></header><section class="case-intro"><div class="case-lead" id="caseLead">A clear, confident one-line description of the project and the creative opportunity.</div><div class="case-copy"><p>Case study content area. This build deliberately uses no object imagery inside the case study.</p><p>The layout follows the supplied case-study structure so project content can be added without changing the interaction system.</p><div class="facts"><div class="fact">Role<b>Creative Lead</b></div><div class="fact">Client<b id="caseClient"></b></div><div class="fact">Year<b>2026</b></div></div></div></section><div class="case-visual">HERO VISUAL</div><section class="case-story"><h2>The idea</h2><p>A simple thought with enough energy to travel across every touchpoint.</p></section><div class="case-split"><div>IMAGE / FILM</div><div>IMAGE / DETAIL</div></div><section class="case-story"><h2>The system</h2><p>One clear creative language, flexed across campaign, brand, motion and experience.</p></section><div class="case-visual">WIDE EXECUTION</div><section class="case-story case-impact"><h2>The impact</h2><p>Use this final section for results, response and what the work achieved.</p></section></div></section>
<script>
const projects=[{"title":"The Great Unwaste","client":"End Food Waste Australia","model":"apple.glb"},{"title":"Discover Your Sleep Super Powers","client":"ResMed","model":"alarm-clock.glb"},{"title":"Takeover Tomorrow","client":"Adobe","model":"computer.glb"},{"title":"It's Time to Play Better","client":"Park SSC","model":"soccer.glb"},{"title":"The Unfairest Cricket Match","client":"Massel","model":"cricket.glb"},{"title":"I'm Prep'd","client":"Aids Council of New South Wales","model":"underwear.glb"},{"title":"Scott Pizza","client":"Pizza Hut","model":"meat-pie.glb"},{"title":"CX Artist Series","client":"Converse","model":"converse.glb"},{"title":"3% P.A. Savings Account","client":"Westpac","model":"piggy-bank.glb"},{"title":"What Are You Really Driving","client":"Permaguard Anti Microbial Shield","model":"toilet.glb"},{"title":"Our Routes Grow Trees","client":"Warrington Borough Transport","model":"bus-stop.glb"},{"title":"Get Fit for the Galaxy","client":"Marvel","model":"star-lord_action_figure.glb"}];
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const grid=$('#grid'),gallery=$('#gallery'),caseEl=$('#case'),topbar=$('#topbar'),menuPanel=$('#menuPanel');
/* V20: 3D object cards removed; project index is injected after the legacy script. */
const menuProjects=$('#menuProjects');projects.forEach((p,i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='menu-row';b.innerHTML=`<span>${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')}. ${p.title}</span><span>${p.client}</span>`;b.onclick=()=>{toggleMenu(false);openCase(i)};menuProjects.append(b)});const mt=$('#menuToggle'),mc=$('#menuClose');function toggleMenu(force){const on=force??!menuPanel.classList.contains('open');menuPanel.classList.toggle('open',on);mt.setAttribute('aria-expanded',on)}mt.onclick=()=>toggleMenu();mc.onclick=()=>toggleMenu(false);document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){toggleMenu(false);if(caseEl.classList.contains('open'))closeCase()}});
// Shared, lightweight object motion. Y-axis only: no top/bottom reveal and no scale changes.
const objectStates=[];document.querySelectorAll('.object-card').forEach((card,i)=>{const mv=card.querySelector('model-viewer'),hit=card.querySelector('.hit');if(!mv)return;const st={mv,hit,i,drag:false,moved:false,startX:0,startY:0,theta:0,target:0,lastX:0,phase:i*.73};objectStates.push(st);hit.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{st.startX=st.lastX=e.clientX;st.startY=e.clientY;st.drag=false;st.moved=false});hit.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const dx=e.clientX-st.startX,dy=e.clientY-st.startY;if(!st.drag&&Math.abs(dx)>8&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.15){st.drag=true;hit.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}if(st.drag){e.preventDefault();st.moved=true;st.theta+=(e.clientX-st.lastX)*.42;st.target=st.theta;st.lastX=e.clientX}else if(matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches){const r=card.getBoundingClientRect(),nx=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5;st.target=nx*8}});hit.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{if(st.drag){try{hit.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch{}st.drag=false}else if(!st.moved&&Math.hypot(e.clientX-st.startX,e.clientY-st.startY)<8)openCase(+card.dataset.i)});hit.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{if(!st.drag)st.target=0});card.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();openCase(+card.dataset.i)}})});
function animateObjects(t){for(const st of objectStates){if(!st.drag){const idle=Math.sin(t*.00065+st.phase)*6;st.theta+=(st.target+idle-st.theta)*.035}st.mv.cameraOrbit=`${st.theta.toFixed(2)}deg 75deg auto`}requestAnimationFrame(animateObjects)}requestAnimationFrame(animateObjects);

<style id="v20-selected-work-list">
/* V20 — replace 3D object grid with editorial project index. Intro/physics + case studies remain intact. */
html,body,a,button,[role="button"],.menu-row,.project-row,.case-close,.menu-close,.menu-toggle{cursor:url("ideas-fc-logo.svg") 8 8,auto!important}
.object-grid{display:block!important;padding:0!important;min-height:calc(100dvh - 70px)!important;position:relative!important;background:#171717!important;color:#fff!important}
.work-browser{position:relative;min-height:calc(100dvh - 70px);overflow:hidden;background:#171717}
.work-bg,.work-bg-next{position:absolute;inset:0;background-position:center;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;transition:opacity .38s ease,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.22,.78,.18,1);transform:scale(1.015);pointer-events:none}
.work-bg{opacity:.72}.work-bg-next{opacity:0}.work-browser::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.16),rgba(0,0,0,.22) 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.76) 100%);pointer-events:none}
.project-index{position:relative;z-index:3;width:min(42vw,610px);margin-left:auto;padding:6vh 4vw 8vh;min-height:calc(100dvh - 70px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.project-index-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;margin-bottom:18px;opacity:.62}
.project-row{appearance:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:transparent;color:#fff;width:100%;padding:11px 0 10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:42px 1fr;text-align:left;align-items:start;transition:color .18s,opacity .18s;outline:none}
.project-row:first-of-type{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
.project-row .num{font-size:9px;line-height:1.35;opacity:.62}.project-row .project-name{font-size:clamp(12px,1.05vw,16px);line-height:1.12}.project-row .client{display:block;font-size:8px;line-height:1.25;margin-top:4px;opacity:.55}
.project-row.active,.project-row:hover,.project-row:focus-visible{color:var(--acid)}
.project-index:has(.project-row:hover) .project-row:not(:hover){opacity:.48}
.case-close{position:fixed!important;z-index:1000!important;display:block!important;visibility:visible!important;opacity:1!important}
@media(max-width:900px){
.object-grid{min-height:calc(100dvh - 58px)!important}.work-browser{min-height:calc(100dvh - 58px)}
.work-browser::after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.08) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.28) 42%,rgba(0,0,0,.86) 100%)}
.project-index{width:100%;margin:0;padding:35dvh 18px 48px;min-height:calc(100dvh - 58px);justify-content:flex-start}
.project-index-label{margin-bottom:12px}.project-row{grid-template-columns:36px 1fr;padding:12px 0}.project-row .project-name{font-size:13px}.project-row .client{font-size:8px}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
.gallery:not(.work-docked){overflow:hidden!important;touch-action:none!important}
.gallery.work-docked{overflow-y:auto!important;touch-action:pan-y!important}
.gallery:not(.work-docked) .object-grid{height:calc(100dvh - 58px)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
.work-browser{min-height:calc(100dvh - 58px)}
}
</style>
<script id="v20-work-browser">
(()=>{
const grid=document.getElementById('grid'); if(!grid||typeof projects==='undefined')return;
// Visuals are intentionally conventional image paths so Brendan can drop final hero JPG/WebP files into /project-images.
const visualNames=['great-unwaste','resmed-sleep','adobe-takeover','park-ssc','massel-cricket','prep','scott-pizza','converse-cx','westpac-savings','permaguard','warrington-routes','marvel-galaxy'];
projects.forEach((p,i)=>p.visual=`project-images/${visualNames[i]}.jpg`);
grid.innerHTML='<div class="work-browser"><div class="work-bg" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="work-bg-next" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="project-index"><div class="project-index-label">SELECTED WORK</div><div class="project-rows"></div></div></div>';
const browser=grid.querySelector('.work-browser'), rows=grid.querySelector('.project-rows'), bg=grid.querySelector('.work-bg'), next=grid.querySelector('.work-bg-next');
let active=-1, front=bg, back=next;
function setVisual(i,instant=false){
if(i===active)return; active=i;
grid.querySelectorAll('.project-row').forEach((r,n)=>r.classList.toggle('active',n===i));
back.style.backgroundImage=`url("${projects[i].visual}")`;
if(instant){front.style.backgroundImage=back.style.backgroundImage;front.style.opacity='.72';back.style.opacity='0';return}
back.style.opacity='.72'; front.style.opacity='0';
setTimeout(()=>{const t=front;front=back;back=t;back.style.opacity='0'},390);
}
projects.forEach((p,i)=>{
const b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='project-row'; b.type='button';
b.innerHTML=`<span class="num">[${String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')}]</span><span><span class="project-name">${p.title}</span><small class="client">${p.client}</small></span>`;
b.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>setVisual(i)); b.addEventListener('focus',()=>setVisual(i)); b.addEventListener('click',()=>openCase(i));
rows.appendChild(b);
});
setVisual(0,true);
// Touch/mobile: background follows the row nearest the viewport's active reading line after Work has docked.
function mobileActive(){if(innerWidth>900||!gallery.classList.contains('work-docked'))return;const line=innerHeight*.56;let best=0,dist=1e9;[...rows.children].forEach((r,i)=>{const q=r.getBoundingClientRect(),d=Math.abs((q.top+q.bottom)/2-line);if(d<dist){dist=d;best=i}});setVisual(best)}
gallery.addEventListener('scroll',mobileActive,{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',mobileActive,{passive:true});
// Strong mobile lock: incoming Selected Work is one rigid module; internal scrolling begins only after docking.
let startY=0,lastY=0;
gallery.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(e.touches.length!==1)return;if(!gallery.classList.contains('work-docked')){startY=lastY=e.touches[0].clientY;gallery.scrollTop=0}}, {passive:true});
gallery.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{if(gallery.classList.contains('work-docked')||!startY)return;gallery.scrollTop=0;lastY=e.touches[0].clientY},{passive:true});
gallery.addEventListener('touchend',()=>{startY=lastY=0},{passive:true});
})();
</script>
<style id="v22-mobile-hard-fix">
@media(max-width:700px){
.gallery{position:fixed!important;top:var(--nav-h)!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;height:calc(100dvh - var(--nav-h))!important;overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:auto!important}
.gallery.work-docked{overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior-y:contain!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch!important}

</style>
<script id="v22-mobile-hard-fix-script">
(()=>{
const g=document.getElementById('gallery'),st=document.getElementById('stage');
if(!g||!st)return;
let start=0,last=0,owner='',handled=false;
document.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
if(e.touches.length!==1||caseEl.classList.contains('open')||menuPanel.classList.contains('open')){owner='';return}
start=last=e.touches[0].clientY;handled=false;
owner=(phase==='INTRO'||phase==='ROTATING'||phase==='BALLS'||phase==='TRANSITION')?'intro':(phase==='WORK'&&g.scrollTop<=1?'worktop':'');
},{capture:true,passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{
if(!owner||e.touches.length!==1)return;
const y=e.touches[0].clientY,dy=y-last,total=y-start;last=y;
if(owner==='intro'){
if(phase==='INTRO'&&dy<0){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();window.advanceIntroCopy?.(Math.min(-dy,32)*0.52)}
else if(phase==='ROTATING'){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation()}
else if(phase==='BALLS'||phase==='TRANSITION'){
e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();phase='TRANSITION';transition=clamp(transition-dy/(H*.92));
if(transition>=.999){transition=1;phase='WORK';g.classList.add('work-docked');g.scrollTop=0;st.style.visibility='hidden'}
else if(transition<=.001){transition=0;phase='BALLS'}
}
}else if(owner==='worktop'&&total>10){
e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();handled=true;g.classList.remove('work-docked');g.scrollTop=0;
st.style.visibility='visible';phase='TRANSITION';transition=clamp(1-total/(H*.92));
}
},{capture:true,passive:false});
document.addEventListener('touchend',()=>{
if(owner==='intro'&&phase==='TRANSITION'&&transition>.985){transition=1;phase='WORK';g.classList.add('work-docked');st.style.visibility='hidden'}
if(owner==='worktop'&&handled){if(transition>.94){transition=1;phase='WORK';g.classList.add('work-docked');st.style.visibility='hidden'}else if(transition<.02){transition=0;phase='BALLS'}}
owner='';handled=false;
},{capture:true,passive:true});
})();
</script>
<style id="v23-agreed">

.v23-row .n{font-size:9px;opacity:.55}.v23-row .t{font-size:clamp(14px,1.45vw,23px);line-height:1.02;text-transform:uppercase}.v23-row .c{display:block;font-size:8px;margin-top:4px;opacity:.6;text-transform:uppercase}.v23-row.active .t{color:var(--acid)}
.v23-mobile{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px){
.v23-desktop{display:none}.v23-mobile{display:block;padding:14px 14px 72px}

.v23-meta{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:20px;color:#fff}.v23-meta .n{font-size:8px;margin-bottom:8px}.v23-meta .t{font-size:clamp(20px,6.4vw,31px);line-height:.96;text-transform:uppercase;max-width:14ch}.v23-meta .c{font-size:9px;margin-top:8px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75}
.gallery{position:fixed!important;top:var(--nav-h)!important;left:0!important;right:0!important;bottom:0!important;height:calc(100dvh - var(--nav-h))!important;overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important}

}
</style><script id="v23-agreed-js">
(()=>{
const g=document.getElementById('gallery'),old=document.getElementById('grid'),logo=document.getElementById('heroLogo'),st=document.getElementById('stage');
if(!g||!old||typeof projects==='undefined')return;
const imgs=['great-unwaste.jpg','resmed-sleep.jpg','adobe-takeover.jpg','park-ssc.jpg','massel-cricket.jpg','prep.jpg','scott-pizza.jpg','converse-cx.jpg','westpac-savings.jpg','permaguard.jpg','warrington-routes.jpg','marvel-galaxy.jpg'].map(x=>'project-images/'+x);
const browser=document.createElement('div');browser.className='v23-browser';
const desk=document.createElement('div');desk.className='v23-desktop';const bgbox=document.createElement('div'),shade=document.createElement('div'),list=document.createElement('div');shade.className='v23-shade';list.className='v23-list';const bgs=[];
projects.forEach((p,i)=>{const bg=document.createElement('div');bg.className='v23-bg'+(i?'':' active');bg.style.backgroundImage=`url("${imgs[i]}")`;bgbox.append(bg);bgs.push(bg);
const r=document.createElement('button');r.className='v23-row'+(i?'':' active');r.innerHTML=`<span class="n">[${String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')}]</span><span><span class="t">${p.title}</span><span class="c">${p.client}</span></span>`;
const a=()=>{bgs.forEach((x,j)=>x.classList.toggle('active',j===i));list.querySelectorAll('.v23-row').forEach((x,j)=>x.classList.toggle('active',j===i))};r.onmouseenter=a;r.onfocus=a;r.onclick=()=>openCase(i);list.append(r)});
desk.append(bgbox,shade,list);
const mob=document.createElement('div');mob.className='v23-mobile';
projects.forEach((p,i)=>{const t=document.createElement('article');t.className='v23-tile';t.tabIndex=0;t.innerHTML=`<img src="${imgs[i]}" alt=""><div class="v23-meta"><div class="n">[${String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')}]</div><div class="t">${p.title}</div><div class="c">${p.client}</div></div>`;t.onclick=()=>openCase(i);t.onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();openCase(i)}};mob.append(t)});
browser.append(desk,mob);old.replaceWith(browser);
if(matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches){const c=document.createElement('img');c.id='ideasCursor';c.src='ideas-fc-cursor.svg';c.alt='';document.body.append(c);let tx=innerWidth/2,ty=innerHeight/2,x=tx,y=ty,seen=false;addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{tx=e.clientX;ty=e.clientY;seen=true},{passive:true});(function tick(){x+=(tx-x)*.16;y+=(ty-y)*.16;if(seen)c.style.transform=`translate3d(${x-8}px,${y-8}px,0)`;requestAnimationFrame(tick)})()}
if(matchMedia('(max-width:700px)').matches){
let sy=0,back=false;
const hide=()=>{document.body.classList.add('v23-postlogo');if(logo){logo.style.display='none';logo.style.opacity='0';logo.style.visibility='hidden'}};
(function guard(){if(['BALLS','TRANSITION','WORK'].includes(phase))hide();if(phase==='WORK'&&transition>=.999){if(!g.classList.contains('work-docked')){g.classList.add('work-docked');g.scrollTop=0}}else if(transition<.999&&g.classList.contains('work-docked')){g.classList.remove('work-docked');g.scrollTop=0}requestAnimationFrame(guard)})();
g.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{sy=(e.touches.length===1&&g.classList.contains('work-docked')&&g.scrollTop<=1)?e.touches[0].clientY:0;back=false},{capture:true,passive:true});
g.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{if(!sy||g.scrollTop>1)return;const d=e.touches[0].clientY-sy;if(d>10){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();back=true;g.classList.remove('work-docked');g.scrollTop=0;st.style.visibility='visible';phase='TRANSITION';transition=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,1-d/(H*.82)));g.style.transform=`translateY(${(1-transition)*100}%)`;hide()}},{capture:true,passive:false});
g.addEventListener('touchend',()=>{if(back){if(transition>.92){transition=1;phase='WORK';g.style.transform='translateY(0)';g.classList.add('work-docked');st.style.visibility='hidden'}else if(transition<.05){transition=0;phase='BALLS';g.style.transform='translateY(100%)';st.style.visibility='visible'}}sy=0;back=false},{capture:true,passive:true});
}
})();
</script>
<style id="v24-final-refinements">
/* HEADER: 150px Ideas FC SVG + two-line identity. Entire lockup is Home. */
.topbar{padding-left:24px!important}
.v24-home{
pointer-events:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;height:100%;
border:0;background:none;padding:0;text-align:left;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;
}
.v24-home-logo{display:block;width:150px;height:auto;max-height:42px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center}
.v24-home-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}
.v24-home-name{font-size:11px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em}
.v24-home-title{font-size:9px;line-height:1.2;margin-top:4px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.01em}
.topbar>.identity{display:none!important}
/* DESKTOP SELECTED WORK: no overlay, compact one-line editorial list. */
@media(min-width:701px){
.v23-desktop{background:#111}
.v23-shade{display:none!important}
.v23-bg{transition:none!important;opacity:0}
.v23-bg.active{opacity:1}
.v23-list{
width:auto!important;
min-width:430px;
max-width:min(48vw,680px);
min-height:0!important;
position:absolute!important;
left:6.8vw!important;
right:auto!important;
top:50%!important;
transform:translateY(-50%)!important;
margin:0!important;
padding:0!important;
display:block!important;
color:#fff;
}
.v23-row{
display:block!important;
width:100%;
padding:2px 0!important;
border:0!important;
background:none!important;
white-space:nowrap;
line-height:1.15;
text-align:left;
}
.v23-row .n,
.v23-row .t,
.v23-row .c{
display:inline!important;
font-size:11px!important;
line-height:1.15!important;
letter-spacing:0!important;
text-transform:none!important;
opacity:1!important;
margin:0!important;
padding:0!important;
color:inherit;
}
.v23-row .n{margin-right:7px!important}
.v23-row .c:before{content:" — "}
.v23-row.active,
.v23-row.active .n,
.v23-row.active .t,
.v23-row.active .c{color:var(--acid)!important}
}
/* Mobile header stays usable: smaller header logo, same two-line lockup. */
@media(max-width:700px){
.topbar{padding:0 14px!important}
.v24-home{gap:10px;max-width:calc(100vw - 58px)}
.v24-home-logo{width:72px;max-height:34px}
.v24-home-name{font-size:10px}
.v24-home-title{font-size:7px;margin-top:3px;white-space:nowrap}
}
</style>
<script id="v24-final-refinements-js">
(()=>{
const topbar=document.getElementById('topbar');
const identity=topbar?.querySelector('.identity');
const gallery=document.getElementById('gallery');
const caseEl=document.getElementById('case');
const stage=document.getElementById('stage');
const heroLogo=document.getElementById('heroLogo');
if(!topbar||!identity||!gallery||!stage||!heroLogo)return;
/* Add requested 150px SVG brand mark + revised titles. */
const home=document.createElement('button');
home.className='v24-home';
home.type='button';
home.setAttribute('aria-label','Back to start');
home.innerHTML=`<img class="v24-home-logo" src="ideas-fc-logo.svg" alt="">
<span class="v24-home-copy">
<span class="v24-home-name">BRENDAN MCGOVERN</span>
<span class="v24-home-title">CREATIVE LEAD + ART DIRECTOR + DESIGNER</span>
</span>`;
topbar.insertBefore(home,identity);
/* Home means the literal beginning: close overlays, reset work, restore opening logo. */
home.addEventListener('click',()=>{
try{ if(caseEl?.classList.contains('open')) finishCaseReturn(); }catch(e){}
try{ toggleMenu(false); }catch(e){}
gallery.classList.remove('work-docked','gallery-under');
gallery.scrollTop=0;
transition=0;
phase='INTRO';
stage.style.visibility='visible';
gallery.style.transform='translateY(100%)';
document.body.classList.remove('v23-postlogo','v23-work','v23-balls','mobile-balls','mobile-work');
heroLogo.style.removeProperty('display');
heroLogo.style.removeProperty('visibility');
heroLogo.style.removeProperty('opacity');
heroLogo.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0deg)';
logoTurn=0; logoTurnTarget=0;
cue.style.opacity='1';
try{spawnBalls(false)}catch(e){}
window.scrollTo(0,0);
});
/* Convert desktop rows to one-line [001] Project — Brand while retaining click/open behavior.
Hover/background switch remains immediate because V24 removes the previous fade transition. */
const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v23-row')];
rows.forEach((row,i)=>{
const p=projects[i];
if(!p)return;
row.innerHTML=`<span class="n">[${String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')}]</span><span class="t">${p.title}</span><span class="c">${p.client}</span>`;
});
})();
</script>
<style id="v25-intro-copy-selected-work">
/* V29 — word-by-word reveal; every letter follows one continuous circular spiral. */
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Anton&display=swap');
.gallery-head{display:none!important}
.v23-browser,.v23-desktop{min-height:100%!important;height:100%!important}
@media(min-width:701px){
.v23-list{max-width:min(68vw,1120px)!important}
.v23-list:before{content:"SELECTED WORK";display:block;font-size:18px;line-height:1.1;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 18px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:0}
.v23-row .n,.v23-row .t,.v23-row .c{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.2!important}
.v23-row{padding:3px 0!important}
}
.intro-copy-sequence{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;color:#050505;text-transform:uppercase}
.spiral-letter{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;font-family:'Anton','Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:0;white-space:pre;transition:opacity .16s ease-out;transform-origin:50% 50%;will-change:transform,opacity,filter;opacity:0}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spiral-letter{filter:none!important;transition:none!important}}
@media(max-width:700px){.hero-logo{width:min(44vw,30dvh)!important}}
</style>
<script id="v25-intro-copy-selected-work-js">
(()=>{
const stage=document.getElementById('stage'),logo=document.getElementById('heroLogo'),cue=document.getElementById('cue');
if(!stage||!logo)return;
const WORDS=['CREATE','IDEAS','SO','UNEXPECTED','AND','POWERFUL','THEY','DON’T','JUST','CATCH','THE','EYE','BUT','HIJACK','THE','BRAIN','AND','EXPLODE','IN','THE','MIND'];
const copy=document.createElement('div');copy.className='intro-copy-sequence';copy.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');stage.appendChild(copy);
const chars=[];WORDS.forEach((word,wi)=>[...word].forEach((ch,ci)=>{const el=document.createElement('span');el.className='spiral-letter';el.textContent=ch;copy.appendChild(el);chars.push({el,wi,ci,ch})}));
const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const ease=v=>1-Math.pow(1-clamp(v),3);
const context=document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
window.introCopyProgress=0;
function layout(){
const sr=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),W=sr.width,H=sr.height,mobile=W<=700;
if(!W||!H)return;
// Genuine inward-contracting spiral, with no repeated per-word angles.
// The outermost sweep remains screen-sized; the inner end clears the logo.
const logoRadius=Math.min(logo.offsetWidth,logo.offsetHeight||logo.offsetWidth)/2;
const outer=mobile?Math.min(W*.475,H*.40):Math.min(W*.46,H*.465);
const inner=Math.min(outer*.70,logoRadius+(mobile?13:23));
const turns=mobile?1.72:2.10,sweep=turns*Math.PI*2;
const theta0=-Math.PI*.56;
const exponent=1.48; // ring pitch contracts continuously toward the centre
const radius=t=>inner+(outer-inner)*Math.pow(1-t,exponent);
const steps=1800,arc=new Float64Array(steps+1);let px=outer*Math.cos(theta0),py=outer*Math.sin(theta0);
for(let i=1;i<=steps;i++){
const t=i/steps,theta=theta0+t*sweep,r=radius(t),x=r*Math.cos(theta),y=r*Math.sin(theta);
arc[i]=arc[i-1]+Math.hypot(x-px,y-py);px=x;py=y;
}
const len=arc[steps];
const fontAt=t=>mobile?(12+25*Math.pow(1-t,1.18)):(19+91*Math.pow(1-t,1.24));
const advanceAt=(ch,t)=>{const fs=fontAt(t);context.font=`${fs}px Anton, Impact, sans-serif`;return Math.max(fs*.28,context.measureText(ch).width)+10};
// Solve positions along *one* path by glyph width, rather than distributing words by index.
const segments=[];let guess=0;
for(const [wi,word] of WORDS.entries()){
for(const ch of word){const t=clamp(guess/len);const w=advanceAt(ch,t);segments.push({wi,ch,advance:w});guess+=w}
if(wi<WORDS.length-1){const w=fontAt(clamp(guess/len))*.68;segments.push({gap:true,advance:w});guess+=w}
}
for(let pass=0;pass<5;pass++){
let at=0;for(const item of segments){const t=clamp((at+item.advance*.5)/Math.max(guess,1));item.advance=item.gap?fontAt(t)*.68:advanceAt(item.ch,t);at+=item.advance}guess=at;
}
const fit=Math.min(1,len/Math.max(guess,1)*.965);
let cursor=Math.max(0,(len-guess*fit)*.12),charIndex=0;
const visible=window.introCopyProgress*WORDS.length;
for(const item of segments){
const middle=cursor+item.advance*fit*.5;cursor+=item.advance*fit;
if(item.gap)continue;
let lo=0,hi=steps;while(lo<hi){const mid=(lo+hi)>>1;if(arc[mid]<middle)lo=mid+1;else hi=mid}
const t=clamp(lo/steps),theta=theta0+t*sweep,r=radius(t);
const tangent=theta+Math.PI/2;
const el=chars[charIndex++].el;
const reveal=ease(visible-item.wi);
// Fixed position: only opacity changes during reveal.
el.style.fontSize=(fontAt(t)*fit)+'px';
el.style.opacity=String(reveal);
el.style.filter='none';
el.style.transform=`translate(-50%,-50%) translate(${Math.cos(theta)*r}px,${Math.sin(theta)*r}px) rotate(${tangent}rad)`;
}
copy.style.opacity=phase==='INTRO'?'1':'0';
}
let ending=false;
window.advanceIntroCopy=function(delta){
if(phase!=='INTRO'||ending)return;
window.introCopyProgress=clamp(window.introCopyProgress+Math.max(0,delta)/(WORDS.length*135));
if(cue)cue.style.opacity=window.introCopyProgress>.015?'0':'1';
layout();
if(window.introCopyProgress>=.999){ending=true;setTimeout(()=>{if(phase==='INTRO'){copy.style.opacity='0';startLogoTurn()}ending=false},1800)}
};
addEventListener('resize',layout,{passive:true});if(document.fonts?.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(layout);layout();
let previous=phase;
(function watch(){if(previous!=='INTRO'&&phase==='INTRO'){window.introCopyProgress=0;ending=false;if(cue)cue.style.opacity='1';layout()}if(phase!=='INTRO')copy.style.opacity='0';previous=phase;requestAnimationFrame(watch)})();
})();
</script>
</body></html>
<style id="v15-fixes">
.case-hero{justify-content:flex-end!important;align-items:stretch!important}
.case-hero-copy{margin:0!important;margin-right:auto!important;margin-left:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;padding-left:4vw!important;padding-right:4vw!important;text-align:left!important}
.case-title,.case-client-hero,.case-kicker{text-align:left!important;margin-left:0!important;margin-right:auto!important}
@media(max-width:900px){.case-hero-copy{padding-left:18px!important;padding-right:18px!important}}
/* Work starts as one rigid module. The grid cannot scroll independently before the header docks. */
.gallery.work-docked{overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior-y:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
</style>
<script id="v15-work-lock">
(()=>{
const g=document.getElementById('gallery'); if(!g) return;
const head=g.querySelector('.gallery-head');
let docked=false, startY=0, lastY=0;
function dock(){ if(docked)return; docked=true; g.classList.add('work-docked'); g.scrollTop=0; }
function undock(){ if(!docked)return; docked=false; g.classList.remove('work-docked'); g.scrollTop=0; }
// transition===1 is the exact moment the rigid module has reached the nav.
const watch=()=>{
const tr=(typeof transition==='number')?transition:0;
if(tr>=.999 && phase==='WORK') dock();
else if(tr<.999) undock();
requestAnimationFrame(watch);
}; requestAnimationFrame(watch);
// At the top of docked work, downward motion reconnects the entire module first.
g.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{if(docked&&g.scrollTop<=1&&e.touches.length===1){startY=lastY=e.touches[0].clientY}}, {passive:true});
g.addEventListener('touchmove',e=>{if(!docked||g.scrollTop>1||!startY)return; const y=e.touches[0].clientY,d=y-lastY;if(d>0){e.preventDefault(); undock(); stage.style.visibility='visible'; phase='TRANSITION'; transition=clamp(1-d/(H*.9));} lastY=y;},{passive:false});
g.addEventListener('touchend',()=>{startY=lastY=0},{passive:true});
})();
</script>
<style id="v16-case-ending">
/* V16: every case study ends in a fluorescent Impact module. */
.case-impact{background:var(--acid);min-height:52dvh;margin:0;padding-top:9vw;padding-bottom:9vw}
.return-reveal,.return-note{display:none!important}
@media(max-width:900px){.case-impact{min-height:44dvh;padding:64px 18px 72px}}
</style>
<style id="v17-structural-fixes">
/* V17 — Selected Work has exactly two states: locked while entering, scrollable only after fully docked. */
.gallery{overflow:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior:none!important}
.gallery.work-docked{overflow-y:auto!important;overflow-x:hidden!important;overscroll-behavior-y:contain!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
/* Never let the mobile breakpoint make the incoming module independently scrollable. */
@media(max-width:560px){.gallery:not(.work-docked){overflow:hidden!important}}
/* True page-left alignment for every case-study hero. */
.case-hero{position:relative!important;align-items:stretch!important;justify-content:flex-end!important}
.case-hero-copy{position:absolute!important;left:0!important;right:auto!important;bottom:0!important;transform:none!important;margin:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;padding:0 4vw 7vh!important;text-align:left!important}
.case-title,.case-client-hero,.case-kicker{display:block!important;text-align:left!important;margin-left:0!important;margin-right:auto!important;transform:none!important}
@media(max-width:900px){.case-hero-copy{left:0!important;padding:0 18px 34px!important}}
</style>
<script id="v17-lock-guard">
(()=>{
const g=document.getElementById('gallery');
if(!g)return;
// Guard against any earlier listener changing scrollTop while the module is still entering.
const keepLocked=()=>{
const docked=g.classList.contains('work-docked');
if(!docked && g.scrollTop!==0) g.scrollTop=0;
requestAnimationFrame(keepLocked);
};
requestAnimationFrame(keepLocked);
})();
</script>
